title: A $9 Billion Company. The Machine Never Worked. #shorts
description:
Theranos promised hundreds of blood tests from a single drop of blood and was valued at nine billion dollars. Behind closed doors, the technology never worked.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
first_comment: Who failed worse: the founder, or the famous investors who never asked to see it work? 👇

lines.text: A nine billion dollar company, built on a machine that never worked.
So how did it fool everyone for over ten years?
Theranos promised hundreds of tests from one drop of blood.
Investors poured in hundreds of millions. Pharmacies put it in their stores.
Its founder became a billionaire on paper.
But secretly, most tests ran on other companies' machines.
Then employees started talking to a reporter.
In twenty fifteen, the Wall Street Journal exposed it all.
Nine billion dollars fell to zero. Elizabeth Holmes got over eleven years for fraud.
All of it, from a single drop of blood.
